_howto: Time & Attendance tours. steps = page tour. sections = one tour per screen (first visit) plus pop-up form tours. Guides are in tna_dashboard_guides.json. Never reuse a step id.
title: Time & Attendance tour
whatsNewText: We've added something new here since you last took the tour.

steps.title: Welcome to Time & Attendance
steps.text:
Clockings come in from the devices and the app, are matched to each person's shift, and become worked hours, overtime and exceptions, ready for payroll.

Use Next and Back, or your arrow keys. Press Esc to close.

steps.title: All screens
steps.text: Every screen is listed here. You only see those your role allows. Set up in this order: System Settings, Shift Rules, Overtime Rules, Workflow Routing, then the Weekly Roster.

steps.title: Global Master Data
steps.text: The full Employee Master, opened inside Time & Attendance.

steps.title: High Level Overview
steps.text: Company-wide attendance at a glance, across sites and departments.

steps.title: Maps
steps.text: Where people clocked, on a map, including geofence violations.

steps.title: Dashboard
steps.text: Today: who's in, late, absent, on leave or working overtime. Click a number to see the people.

steps.title: Shift Rules
steps.text: Your shifts: times, breaks, grace periods, overtime and allowances. Everything is calculated from these.

steps.title: Weekly Roster
steps.text: Which shift each person works on each day, one week at a time.

steps.title: Manager Inbox
steps.text: Requests and exceptions waiting for a manager's decision.

steps.title: Team View
steps.text: A team's week at a glance, per person and day.

steps.title: New: Visual Team View
steps.text: Team View now has a Visual tab: each person's day on a timeline with the shift, clock times, normal time, overtime, breaks and late starts. Drag a clock time to fix it, decide on overtime and approve days, one at a time or for everyone you tick.

steps.title: Actual Attendance
steps.text: The worked hours per person and day, as calculated from the clockings and the shift.

steps.title: Auto-Violations
steps.text: Late arrivals, early departures, missed clockings and break violations, found automatically.

steps.title: OT Validations
steps.text: Overtime waiting to be approved before it's paid.

steps.title: Time Logs
steps.text: Every clocking from the devices and the mobile app, as it came in.

steps.title: Analytics & Reports
steps.text: Attendance, overtime, leave, violations and payroll-ready reports.

steps.title: Workflow Routing
steps.text: Who approves what: approvers per department or person, and stand-ins.

steps.title: Overtime Rules
steps.text: The BCEA limits and pay rates, and your own rulesets for groups or people.

steps.title: Sage Push Queue
steps.text: What's waiting to be sent to Sage payroll, and what was sent.

steps.title: System Settings
steps.text: How the engine calculates: holidays, rounding, night shifts, geofences, payroll periods and department defaults.

steps.title: Make more room
steps.text: Collapse the menu to icons only, and click again to open it.

steps.title: Search any screen
steps.text: Type what you're looking for, like roster or overtime, to jump straight to any screen you have access to, in any module.

steps.title: Your menu
steps.text: Click your name for your profile, other areas of the system, Dark Mode and logout.

steps.title: Launchpad
steps.text: Back to your home screen with all your modules.

steps.title: Help & Tours
steps.text: Opens the same help menu as the ? button.

steps.title: Dark Mode
steps.text: Switch between dark and light. Your choice follows your login to any computer.

steps.title: Help is always here
steps.text: Click ? for this tour, a tour of the screen you're on, what's new, and hands-on how-to guides such as creating a shift or building a roster.

steps.title: You're all set
steps.text: Each screen also has its own short tour. It starts the first time you open that screen, and you can replay it any time from ?.

steps.title: Create Shift
steps.text: A shift sets the expected times and how the engine treats a day on it: breaks, grace periods, overtime, allowances.

steps.title: Your shifts
steps.text: Each shift's times, automatic break, grace periods and thresholds. Use the edit button to change one; the change applies to days calculated from then on.

steps.title: Two ways to work
steps.text: Grid View: a week per department, one row per person. Bulk Assignment: one shift for many people over a date range.

steps.title: Department and week
steps.text: Choose a department and move between weeks with the arrows. Search narrows the list.

steps.title: Each person's week
steps.text: Click a day to set that person's shift for it. Changes wait until you save them.

steps.title: Auto-Populate Defaults
steps.text: Fill the week from each person's default shift and working days in one go.

steps.title: Patterns
steps.text: Repeat a rotating pattern, such as 4 days on and 4 off, over a number of cycles, skipping Sundays or holidays if you want.

steps.title: Excel
steps.text: Download a roster template, fill it in, and upload it.

steps.title: Save & Recalculate
steps.text: Saves your changes and recalculates attendance for the days you changed. Cancel throws them away.

steps.title: Who overtime applies to
steps.text: The BCEA annual earnings threshold. Employees earning more than it aren't covered by the overtime limits.

steps.title: Limits
steps.text: The maximum overtime per week and the maximum total hours per day. Going over is flagged as a violation.

steps.title: Weekends
steps.text: Whether Saturday work is automatically overtime, and Sunday automatically paid at 2.0x.

steps.title: Rates and grace
steps.text: The pay multipliers for overtime, Sunday and public holidays, and the statutory grace period.

steps.title: Save Global Defaults
steps.text: These apply to everyone without their own ruleset.

steps.title: Custom Rulesets
steps.text: Different limits and rates for a group or person, such as security guards. Give it to employees in Employee Master, or to a shift.

steps.title: Your rulesets
steps.text: Each ruleset's method, limits and rates.

steps.title: Approvers and stand-ins
steps.text: Approval chains set who approves; Stand-ins cover someone who's away.

steps.title: For a department or a person
steps.text: Choose a department, or one employee for their own approvers (this overrides their department).

steps.title: The approvers
steps.text: A request goes to the 1st approver, then the 2nd and 3rd. The standing approver is the backup.

steps.title: Save
steps.text: Requests from then on follow this rule.

steps.title: Your rules
steps.text: Every department and personal rule; search or filter by type.

steps.title: How the engine calculates
steps.text: Ignoring overtime within a threshold, making up short time, filtering duplicate clockings, auto-ignoring geofence violations, how hours are shown, where a night shift's day ends, what a recalculation re-opens, and how public holidays and leave on premium days are treated.

steps.title: Public Holidays
steps.text: Add the date and name, and whether people get normal time for it.

steps.title: Approved Geolocations
steps.text: Places where clocking on the app is allowed: a name, the map point and a radius.

steps.title: Save
steps.text: Saves the engine settings above. Holidays, leave types and geolocations save as you add them.

steps.title: Payroll periods
steps.text: The same payroll periods as Employee Master › Payroll Periods, where you can also assign them to departments and people.

steps.title: Department defaults
steps.text: The default shift, payroll period and geofences per department. Tick departments and apply them in bulk.

steps.title: Bulk Analyzer
steps.text: Recalculates attendance for a date range and department, for example after changing a shift. Tick overwrite to redo days already calculated.

steps.title: Traditional or Visual
steps.text: Traditional is the approvals table you know. Visual shows one day on a timeline. The screen remembers which one you used last.

steps.title: Overview
steps.text: Everyone's day, or a week, two weeks or a month, compressed so problems stand out: red for missing clockings, yellow for overtime to approve. Click any day to fix it in Visual. Print / Save PDF prints it.

steps.title: Pick the day
steps.text: Visual works on one day at a time, for everyone you're allowed to see. No department is needed. Use search, department and shift to narrow it down.

steps.title: Click a number to filter
steps.text: Scheduled, approved, not approved, OT to approve and more. Click one to see only those people; click it again to see everyone.

steps.title: Each person's day
steps.text: The top bar is the shift. Below it is what happened: green normal time, yellow overtime, red late or early, amber time inside the threshold (not overtime), grey the break. Hover any part for the times.

steps.title: Drag a clock time
steps.text: Drag a white handle to move a clock-in or clock-out, or double-click it to type the time. Saving adds the new clocking and ignores the old one, then recalculates the day.

steps.title: Decide on overtime
steps.text: Click overtime to approve or decline it. Overtime before the shift and after it are decided separately, and only the approved part is paid. Amber time inside the threshold isn't overtime, but you can still give it as overtime.

steps.title: Times for this day only
steps.text: Drag either end of a shift to change its times for this person's day only. The shift setup is not changed. Click the shift to type the times or to change the shift.

steps.title: Breaks
steps.text: Drag a break to move it, or drag its ends to make it longer or shorter. Click the green normal time to add another break.

steps.title: Late or left early
steps.text: Click it to cover the time with partial leave, or to replenish normal time from time worked before or after the shift. Leave it and it stays unpaid, with no leave deducted.

steps.title: Many people at once
steps.text: Tick rows and a drag on one ticked row goes to all of them: the same time, or the same move (+/- minutes), as set in Ticked rows get. Ticked rows can also be approved or unlocked together.

steps.title: Approve the day
steps.text: Approves the person's day, the same as in Traditional. A day with missing clockings or overtime still to decide can't be approved yet. Hover Approved to unlock it again.
